name: Alibaba Group Holding Limited
_sources_used: Alibaba Group 20-F SEC EDGAR CIK 0001577552 (FY2024 annual report)

kpis.description_fr: CA total FY25 (mars 2025) en CNY. Croissance modérée, reflète maturité du marché e-commerce chinois.
kpis.description_en: Total FY25 revenue (ending March 2025) in CNY. Moderate growth reflecting maturity of China e-commerce.

kpis.description_fr: Op Margin 14.1% en hausse. Restructuration en 6 unités opérationnelles porte ses fruits.
kpis.description_en: Op Margin 14.1% up. 6-unit operational restructuring delivers results.

kpis.description_fr: Forte hausse FY25 portée par plus-values cessions et reprise opérationnelle.
kpis.description_en: Strong FY25 increase driven by divestiture gains and operational recovery.

kpis.description_fr: FCF en baisse marquée FY25 due CapEx massif cloud + IA infrastructure (datacenters, GPU).
kpis.description_en: Sharp FCF drop FY25 from massive cloud + AI infrastructure CapEx (datacenters, GPU).

kpis.description_fr: Cloud Intelligence Group avec Alibaba Cloud + DAMO Academy. Croissance accélérée Q4 grâce à IA Qwen et clients externes.
kpis.description_en: Cloud Intelligence Group with Alibaba Cloud + DAMO Academy. Q4 growth accelerated by Qwen AI and external customers.

kpis.description_fr: GMV total Taobao + Tmall (commerce de détail Chine). Plus grande plateforme e-commerce Chine. Croissance ralentie face Pinduoduo et Douyin.
kpis.description_en: Total Taobao + Tmall GMV (China retail commerce). Largest e-commerce platform in China. Growth slowed by Pinduoduo and Douyin.

kpis.description_fr: AIDC : AliExpress + Lazada + Trendyol + Daraz + Miravia. Croissance internationale forte malgré pertes opérationnelles.
kpis.description_en: AIDC: AliExpress + Lazada + Trendyol + Daraz + Miravia. Strong international growth despite operating losses.

kpis.description_fr: Plateforme logistique mondiale connectant marchands, transporteurs et consommateurs. Hub stratégique cross-border.
kpis.description_en: Global logistics platform connecting merchants, carriers and consumers. Strategic cross-border hub.

kpis.description_fr: Mesure de référence rentabilité opérationnelle (Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Amortization) ajustée des éléments non-récurrents.
kpis.description_en: Reference operating profitability metric (Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Amortization) adjusted for non-recurring items.

kpis.description_fr: BPA dilué en CNY. Forte hausse FY25 portée par buybacks (réduction shares) et plus-values cessions.
kpis.description_en: Diluted EPS in CNY. Strong FY25 surge from buybacks (share reduction) and divestiture gains.
